p: was glad when they said unto: He rejoices that God had appointed a place where the ark would still remain.
feet shall stand within thy gates: Which were wont to wander to and fro, as the ark moved.
compact together: By the artificial joining and beauty of the houses, he means the peace and love that was between the citizens.
the tribes go up: All the tribes according to God's covenant will come and pray there.
David: In whose house God placed the throne of justice, and made it a figure of Christ's kingdom.
walls: The favour of God prosper you both within and without.
brethren and companions' sakes: Not only for my own sake but for all the faithful.
